metadata.name: pegwar
metadata.description: Peg War: multiplayer Plinko on MagicBlock's private rollup

instructions.name: abort
docs: The dice never came: end the round with no points so everyone can be refunded.

instructions.name: arm
docs: Hand the ticking to the rollup itself: schedule `tick` every 250 ms with MagicBlock's
crank, signed by the Board PDA. Anyone can call it once the board is LIVE; clients keep a
heartbeat as a fallback, and `advance` makes extra ticks harmless.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Host calls it off before the round starts: everyone gets their buy-in back.
Pass every player's wallet as remaining accounts, in join order.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pay one player their share of the pot: pot x their points / everyone's points.
Anyone can call it for anyone; the money only ever goes to that player.
A round with no points (the dice never came) refunds each buy-in.

instructions.name: close_chat
docs: Round over: close the chat so its rent goes back to the Board before it leaves the rollup.

instructions.name: create_round
docs: Open a round. The host pre-funds the rent the Board and Seed need for their
read permissions on the private rollup, so nobody needs lamports there.
`price` is each player's per-ball deposit in lamports. With `usd_cents` > 0 the ball's
real cost is locked in dollars from MagicBlock's price feed when the round starts
(capped at `price`), and the unspent deposit is refunded at payout.

instructions.name: delegate_pda
docs: Hand the Board or Seed PDA to the private rollup. With `seal`, a delegation action runs
`init_permission` inside the rollup the moment the account lands: the Board opens to
everyone and the Seed is sealed from its very first slot there, with no extra transaction.

instructions.name: drop_ball
docs: Drop your next ball (it leaves at the next tick your release gap allows).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The seated wallet itself, or a session key it approved.

instructions.name: faucet
docs: Devnet faucet: 100 test-USDC to the caller's token account.

instructions.name: finish
docs: Every ball has landed: reveal the seed on the public Board, hand both accounts back to
Solana, and pay everyone in the same Solana transaction with a Magic Action. The Board
pays for its own commit, so anyone can send this and no wallet has to sign for the money.

instructions.name: finish_manual
docs: Fallback finish if the Magic Action path ever fails: same reveal and commit, paid for by
the caller's wallet, then anyone runs `claim` on Solana.

instructions.name: init_permission
docs: Create the read permission for a delegated PDA, paid from its own pre-funded rent.
The Board is public (`None`); the Seed is private with no readers at all (`Some([])`).
Runs as the delegation action above, or from a client as a fallback (it's idempotent).

instructions.name: join
docs: Buy in: `price` per ball for 1..=BALLS balls, straight into a vault that never leaves Solana.

instructions.name: open_chat
docs: Open the round's trash-talk log: an Ephemeral Account that lives only on the rollup and
is never written to Solana. Its rent comes out of the delegated Board.

instructions.name: payout
docs: Runs on Solana as the Magic Action scheduled by `finish`, right after the round is back.
Accounts are found by address, not position, and it can't fail on money edge cases:
a failing action would roll back the whole commit.

instructions.name: place_bet
docs: Spectators back a player with test-USDC, gasless on the rollup, until the dice are rolled.
The stake moves from the bettor's rollup token account into the Board's Magic ATA.

instructions.name: place_bumper
docs: Put one of your 3 bumpers on a peg: the first rival ball to hit it gets knocked your way.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The seated wallet itself, or a session key it approved.

instructions.name: say
docs: Say something. Players post under their seat colour, spectators as seat 255.
The Board is read-only here so chat never blocks a tick.

instructions.name: seed_board
docs: The VRF oracle's answer, sealed into the private Seed account. Every bounce of every
ball comes from it, and nobody can read it until the round is over.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: settle_bets
docs: Round over: winning bets split the whole pool by stake; if nobody backed the winner,
everyone gets their stake back. The Board signs for its Magic ATA. Pass every bettor's
token account as remaining accounts, in bet order.

instructions.name: start
docs: Lock the lobby and roll the fair dice. Only the host, once the round is on the rollup.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The host's wallet, or the session key it approved; also pays for the dice (free on the rollup).

instructions.name: tick
docs: Move the board up to now. Anyone can call it: clients heartbeat it, the crank schedules it.

errors.name: NotHost
errors.msg: Only the host can do that.

errors.name: WrongPhase
errors.msg: Not allowed in this phase of the round.

errors.name: NoBalls
errors.msg: You have no balls left to drop.

errors.name: BadBumper
errors.msg: That peg can't take a bumper, or you have none left.

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: Too early to abort; the dice may still land.

errors.name: BadPrice
errors.msg: The SOL/USD price feed is missing or stale.

errors.name: NotYourSeat
errors.msg: That wallet didn't sign, and there's no live session key for it.

errors.name: BetsClosed
errors.msg: Bets close when the dice are rolled.

errors.name: BadBet
errors.msg: Pick a seated player, bet more than zero; 12 bets per round.

types.name: Board
docs: Public: everyone watches this live on the rollup.

types.name: Chat
docs: Rollup-only ring buffer of the last CHAT_SLOTS messages.

types.name: Seed
docs: Private: nobody can read it on the rollup. Revealed when the round ends.
